correctness.rationale: Reconstructed G_p on F_p^* with adjacency iff ab+1 mod p is in the set {r^2:r mod p}, zero included. A desired tuple is exactly a clique. Read frozen verify.py and all 70 rows of SPECTRUM.csv; checked branch-and-bound correctness: each candidate pool is partitioned by choosing a vertex, greedy independent color classes give valid clique upper bound for each processed prefix, and pruning only occurs if bound <= actual best. Independent DIFFERENT exact bitset coloring and recursive clique algorithm computed omega(G_p) for ALL 70 odd primes 3..353 and reproduced every first-prime threshold and M(353)=12, with direct verification of all 66 pairs of twelve-element witness. The proof is exhaustive finite computation, not a heuristic random search or extrapolation to larger primes.
